name: @gitgmbh/pi-trinity-mcp
description: Pi extension that delegates prompts to agents on a self-hosted Trinity agent platform (https://github.com/Abilityai/trinity) via its MCP endpoint (HTTP+SSE Streamable transport). Config-less auth via env vars. Surfaces a curated subset of the Trinity MCP
